cuMipmappedArrayCreate.signature: CUresult cuMipmappedArrayCreate(CUmipmappedArray * pHandle, const CUDA_ARRAY3D_DESCRIPTOR * pMipmappedArrayDesc, unsigned int numMipmapLevels)
cuMipmappedArrayCreate.doc:
Creates a CUDA mipmapped array.

Creates a CUDA mipmapped array according to the CUDA_ARRAY3D_DESCRIPTOR structure `pMipmappedArrayDesc` and returns a handle to the new CUDA mipmapped array in `*pHandle`. `numMipmapLevels` specifies the number of mipmap levels to be allocated. This value is clamped to the range [1, 1 + floor(log2(max(width, height, depth)))].

The CUDA_ARRAY3D_DESCRIPTOR is defined as:

`Width`, `Height` and `Depth` must meet certain size requirements as listed in the following table. All values are specified in elements. Note that for brevity’s sake, the full name of the device attribute is not specified. For ex., TEXTURE1D_MIPMAPPED_WIDTH refers to the device attribute [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAXIMUM_TEXTURE1D_MIPMAPPED_WIDTH](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3a73cf80abc3969a6a6a9be1b9f36d7f18).

cuMipmappedArrayDestroy.doc:
Destroys a CUDA mipmapped array.

Destroys the CUDA mipmapped array `hMipmappedArray`.

cuMipmappedArrayGetLevel.signature: CUresult cuMipmappedArrayGetLevel(CUarray * pLevelArray, CUmipmappedArray hMipmappedArray, unsigned int level)
cuMipmappedArrayGetLevel.doc:
Gets a mipmap level of a CUDA mipmapped array.

Returns in `*pLevelArray` a CUDA array that represents a single mipmap level of the CUDA mipmapped array `hMipmappedArray`.

If `level` is greater than the maximum number of levels in this mipmapped array, [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) is returned.

cuMipmappedArrayGetMemoryRequirements.signature: CUresult cuMipmappedArrayGetMemoryRequirements(CUDA_ARRAY_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS * memoryRequirements, CUmipmappedArray mipmap, CUdevice device)
cuMipmappedArrayGetMemoryRequirements.doc:
Returns the memory requirements of a CUDA mipmapped array.

Returns the memory requirements of a CUDA mipmapped array in `memoryRequirements` If the CUDA mipmapped array is not allocated with flag [CUDA_ARRAY3D_DEFERRED_MAPPING](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga854c29dbc47d04a4e42863cb87487d55) [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) will be returned.

The returned value in [CUDA_ARRAY_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS::size](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__MEMORY__REQUIREMENTS__v1.html#structcuda__array__memory__requirements__v1_1a7a2851735a1d2c11af797f01b1d4969e) represents the total size of the CUDA mipmapped array. The returned value in [CUDA_ARRAY_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS::alignment](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__MEMORY__REQUIREMENTS__v1.html#structcuda__array__memory__requirements__v1_1a35c6c8106451b6313d1dffe9a28af755)

represents the alignment necessary for mapping the CUDA mipmapped

array.

mipmap.doc: CUDA mipmapped array to get the memory requirements of.

device.doc: Device to get the memory requirements for.

cuMipmappedArrayGetSparseProperties.doc:
Returns the layout properties of a sparse CUDA mipmapped array.

Returns the sparse array layout properties in `sparseProperties` If the CUDA mipmapped array is not allocated with flag [CUDA_ARRAY3D_SPARSE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga8e13c9d3ef98d1f3dce95901a115abc2) [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) will be returned.

For non-layered CUDA mipmapped arrays, [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::miptailSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a895ecb42681678271b0edba05bf1dcd9) returns the size of the mip tail region. The mip tail region includes all mip levels whose width, height or depth is less than that of the tile. For layered CUDA mipmapped arrays, if [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::flags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a0e842bb64091fa47809112c700cb5f0a) contains [CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES_SINGLE_MIPTAIL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga0dcf4ba7e64caa5c1aa4e88caa7f659a), then [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::miptailSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a895ecb42681678271b0edba05bf1dcd9) specifies the size of the mip tail of all layers combined. Otherwise, [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::miptailSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a895ecb42681678271b0edba05bf1dcd9) specifies mip tail size per layer. The returned value of [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::miptailFirstLevel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1aedd0cca8fad1fcbb1789d537edd7e6b6) is valid only if [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::miptailSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a895ecb42681678271b0edba05bf1dcd9) is non-zero.

mipmap.doc: CUDA mipmapped array to get the sparse properties of.

CU_MODULE_EAGER_LOADING.doc: Lazy Kernel Loading is not enabled.

cuLinkAddData.signature: CUresult cuLinkAddData(CUlinkState state, CUjitInputType type, void * data, size_t size, const char * name, unsigned int numOptions, CUjit_option * options, void * * optionValues)
cuLinkAddData.doc:
Add an input to a pending linker invocation.

Ownership of `data` is retained by the caller. No reference is retained to any inputs after this call returns.

This method accepts only compiler options, which are used if the data must be compiled from PTX, and does not accept any of [CU_JIT_WALL_TIME](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997daf326f19e67f00768bff8849a8dc5def5), [CU_JIT_INFO_LOG_BUFFER](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da0cfba79ec44e0480a78b132ff158c0ae), [CU_JIT_ERROR_LOG_BUFFER](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997daa770301a8ec6fdfb9abcbd60100beb3c), [CU_JIT_TARGET_FROM_CUCONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da8e9b9dfcc1ad8fb0f89bbfb04f46e988), or [CU_JIT_TARGET](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da3bf12ddeaa2a9d64db4d20de537cd596).

type.doc: The type of the input data.

data.doc: The input data. PTX must be NULL-terminated.

size.doc: The length of the input data.

name.doc: An optional name for this input in log messages.

options.doc: Options to be applied only for this input (overrides options from cuLinkCreate).

optionValues.doc: Array of option values, each cast to void \*.

cuLinkAddFile.signature: CUresult cuLinkAddFile(CUlinkState state, CUjitInputType type, const char * path, unsigned int numOptions, CUjit_option * options, void * * optionValues)
cuLinkAddFile.doc:
Add a file input to a pending linker invocation.

No reference is retained to any inputs after this call returns.

This method accepts only compiler options, which are used if the input must be compiled from PTX, and does not accept any of [CU_JIT_WALL_TIME](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997daf326f19e67f00768bff8849a8dc5def5), [CU_JIT_INFO_LOG_BUFFER](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da0cfba79ec44e0480a78b132ff158c0ae), [CU_JIT_ERROR_LOG_BUFFER](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997daa770301a8ec6fdfb9abcbd60100beb3c), [CU_JIT_TARGET_FROM_CUCONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da8e9b9dfcc1ad8fb0f89bbfb04f46e988), or [CU_JIT_TARGET](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da3bf12ddeaa2a9d64db4d20de537cd596).

This method is equivalent to invoking cuLinkAddData on the contents of the file.

type.doc: The type of the input data.

options.doc: Options to be applied only for this input (overrides options from cuLinkCreate).

optionValues.doc: Array of option values, each cast to void \*.

cuLinkComplete.signature: CUresult cuLinkComplete(CUlinkState state, void * * cubinOut, size_t * sizeOut)
cuLinkComplete.doc:
Complete a pending linker invocation.

Completes the pending linker action and returns the cubin image for the linked device code, which can be used with [cuModuleLoadData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1ga04ce266ce03720f479eab76136b90c0b). The cubin is owned by `state`, so it should be loaded before `state` is destroyed via [cuLinkDestroy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1ga01b7ae2a34047b05716969af245ce2d9). This call does not destroy `state`.

cubinOut.doc: On success, this will point to the output image.

sizeOut.doc: Optional parameter to receive the size of the generated image.

cuLinkCreate.signature: CUresult cuLinkCreate(unsigned int numOptions, CUjit_option * options, void * * optionValues, CUlinkState * stateOut)
cuLinkCreate.doc:
Creates a pending JIT linker invocation.

If the call is successful, the caller owns the returned CUlinkState, which should eventually be destroyed with [cuLinkDestroy](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1ga01b7ae2a34047b05716969af245ce2d9). The device code machine size (32 or 64 bit) will match the calling application.

Both linker and compiler options may be specified. Compiler options will be applied to inputs to this linker action which must be compiled from PTX. The options [CU_JIT_WALL_TIME](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997daf326f19e67f00768bff8849a8dc5def5), [CU_JIT_INFO_LOG_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da8dc284de594cc1504db521869ad47cd9), and [CU_JIT_ERROR_LOG_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga5527fa8030d5cabedc781a04dbd1997da4e5c6eb78ba970a0b1683ac040044811) will accumulate data until the CUlinkState is destroyed.

The data passed in via cuLinkAddData and cuLinkAddFile will be treated as relocatable (-rdc=true to nvcc) when linking the final cubin during [cuLinkComplete](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1ga818fcd84a4150a997c0bba76fef4e716) and will have similar consequences as offline relocatable device code linking.

`optionValues` must remain valid for the life of the CUlinkState if output options are used. No other references to inputs are maintained after this call returns.

options.doc: Array of linker and compiler options.

optionValues.doc: Array of option values, each cast to void \*.

stateOut.doc: On success, this will contain a CUlinkState to specify and complete this action.

cuLinkDestroy.doc: Destroys state for a JIT linker invocation.

cuModuleEnumerateFunctions.signature: CUresult cuModuleEnumerateFunctions(CUfunction * functions, unsigned int numFunctions, CUmodule mod)
cuModuleEnumerateFunctions.doc:
Returns the function handles within a module.

Returns in `functions` a maximum number of `numFunctions` function handles within `mod`. When function loading mode is set to LAZY the function retrieved may be partially loaded. The loading state of a function can be queried using ::cuFunctionIsLoaded. CUDA APIs may load the function automatically when called with partially loaded function handle which may incur additional latency. Alternatively, ::cuFunctionLoad can be used to explicitly load a function. The returned function handles become invalid when the module is unloaded.

functions.doc: Buffer where the function handles are returned to.

numFunctions.doc: Maximum number of function handles may be returned to the buffer.

cuModuleGetFunction.signature: CUresult cuModuleGetFunction(CUfunction * hfunc, CUmodule hmod, const char * name)
cuModuleGetFunction.doc:
Returns a function handle.

Returns in `*hfunc` the handle of the function of name `name` located in module `hmod`. If no function of that name exists, [cuModuleGetFunction()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1gaa52be009b0d4045811b30c965e1cb2cf) returns [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aaf1cadbeb21d3a78115ca211ba44c053).

cuModuleGetFunctionCount.signature: CUresult cuModuleGetFunctionCount(unsigned int * count, CUmodule mod)
cuModuleGetFunctionCount.doc:
Returns the number of functions within a module.

Returns in `count` the number of functions in `mod`.

count.doc: Number of functions found within the module.

cuModuleGetGlobal.signature: CUresult cuModuleGetGlobal(CUdeviceptr * dptr, size_t * bytes, CUmodule hmod, const char * name)
cuModuleGetGlobal.doc:
Returns a global pointer from a module.

Returns in `*dptr` and `*bytes` the base pointer and size of the global of name `name` located in module `hmod`. If no variable of that name exists, cuModuleGetGlobal() returns [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aaf1cadbeb21d3a78115ca211ba44c053). One of the parameters `dptr` or `bytes` (not both) can be NULL in which case it is ignored.

cuModuleGetLoadingMode.doc:
Query lazy loading mode.

Returns lazy loading mode Module loading mode is controlled by CUDA_MODULE_LOADING env variable.

cuModuleLoad.signature: CUresult cuModuleLoad(CUmodule * module, const char * fname)
cuModuleLoad.doc:
Loads a compute module.

Takes a filename `fname` and loads the corresponding module `module` into the current context. The CUDA driver API does not attempt to lazily allocate the resources needed by a module; if the memory for functions and data (constant and global) needed by the module cannot be allocated, [cuModuleLoad()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE.html#group__cuda__module_1ga366093bd269dafd0af21f1c7d18115d3) fails. The file should be a *cubin* file as output by **nvcc**, or a *PTX* file either as output by **nvcc** or handwritten, or a *fatbin* file as output by **nvcc** from toolchain 4.0 or later, or a *Tile* IR file.

cuModuleLoadData.signature: CUresult cuModuleLoadData(CUmodule * module, const void * image)
cuModuleLoadData.doc:
Load a module’s data.

Takes a pointer `image` and loads the corresponding module `module` into the current context. The `image` may be a *cubin* or *fatbin* as output by **nvcc**, or a NULL-terminated *PTX*, either as output by **nvcc** or hand-written, or *Tile* IR data.

cuModuleLoadDataEx.signature: CUresult cuModuleLoadDataEx(CUmodule * module, const void * image, unsigned int numOptions, CUjit_option * options, void * * optionValues)
cuModuleLoadDataEx.doc:
Load a module’s data with options.

Takes a pointer `image` and loads the corresponding module `module` into the current context. The `image` may be a *cubin* or *fatbin* as output by **nvcc**, or a NULL-terminated *PTX*, either as output by **nvcc** or hand-written, or *Tile* IR data.

cuModuleLoadFatBinary.signature: CUresult cuModuleLoadFatBinary(CUmodule * module, const void * fatCubin)
cuModuleLoadFatBinary.doc:
Load a module’s data.

Takes a pointer `fatCubin` and loads the corresponding module `module` into the current context. The pointer represents a *fat binary* object, which is a collection of different *cubin* and/or *PTX* files, all representing the same device code, but compiled and optimized for different architectures.

Prior to CUDA 4.0, there was no documented API for constructing and using fat binary objects by programmers. Starting with CUDA 4.0, fat binary objects can be constructed by providing the *-fatbin option* to **nvcc**. More information can be found in the **nvcc** document.

cuModuleUnload.doc:
Unloads a module.

Unloads a module `hmod` from the current context. Attempting to unload a module which was obtained from the Library Management API such as [cuLibraryGetModule](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga0d439597c77b64cf247de33f0609a5d8) will return [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae23d0197c490ec332a43e55b167968a3).

cuModuleGetSurfRef.signature: CUresult cuModuleGetSurfRef(CUsurfref * pSurfRef, CUmodule hmod, const char * name)
cuModuleGetSurfRef.doc:
Returns a handle to a surface reference.

Returns in `*pSurfRef` the handle of the surface reference of name `name` in the module `hmod`. If no surface reference of that name exists, [cuModuleGetSurfRef()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__module__deprecated_1ga71c19dab9374e8481d8d8629a77377b1) returns [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aaf1cadbeb21d3a78115ca211ba44c053).

hmod.doc: Module to retrieve surface reference from.

name.doc: Name of surface reference to retrieve.

cuModuleGetTexRef.signature: CUresult cuModuleGetTexRef(CUtexref * pTexRef, CUmodule hmod, const char * name)
cuModuleGetTexRef.doc:
Returns a handle to a texture reference.

Returns in `*pTexRef` the handle of the texture reference of name `name` in the module `hmod`. If no texture reference of that name exists, [cuModuleGetTexRef()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MODULE__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__module__deprecated_1ga9607dcbf911c16420d5264273f2b5608) returns [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aaf1cadbeb21d3a78115ca211ba44c053). This texture reference handle should not be destroyed, since it will be destroyed when the module is unloaded.

hmod.doc: Module to retrieve texture reference from.

name.doc: Name of texture reference to retrieve.

cuMulticastAddDevice.doc:
Associate a device to a multicast object.

Associates a device to a multicast object. The added device will be a part of the multicast team of size specified by [CUmulticastObjectProp::numDevices](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmulticastObjectProp__v1.html#structcumulticastobjectprop__v1_1ae5d44c9262847a6c74e4ae37acdc7478) during [cuMulticastCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1gad4413361f466d4ed86a93d8c309c0242). The association of the device to the multicast object is permanent during the life time of the multicast object. All devices must be added to the multicast team before any memory can be bound to any device in the team. Any calls to [cuMulticastBindMem](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1gacadf88b616a3f766f6279288e435a4bb), [cuMulticastBindMem_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga0e0ed2e81af121bdcbb54e1a9c4e63a5), [cuMulticastBindAddr](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga07c8cf1d3bf1d04a2d1867f09647b03f), or [cuMulticastBindAddr_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga0eb82d8911bf179ae239d522da049bed) will block until all devices have been added. Similarly all devices must be added to the multicast team before a virtual address range can be mapped to the multicast object. A call to [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) will block until all devices have been added.

This call may fail with [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_DEVICE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a6f047e7215788ca96c81af92a04bfb6c) if the device specified by `dev` does not belong to the same clique as the other devices previously added to this multicast object.

dev.doc: Device that will be associated to the multicast object.

cuMulticastBindAddr.signature: CUresult cuMulticastBindAddr(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle mcHandle, size_t mcOffset, CUdeviceptr memptr, size_t size, unsigned long long flags)
cuMulticastBindAddr.doc:
Bind a memory allocation represented by a virtual address to a multicast object.

Binds a memory allocation specified by its mapped address `memptr` to a multicast object represented by `mcHandle`. The memory must have been allocated via [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) or ::cudaMallocAsync. The intended `size` of the bind, the offset in the multicast range `mcOffset` and `memptr` must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). For best performance however, `size`, `mcOffset` and `memptr` should be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce).

The `size` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` cannot be larger than the total size of the multicast object.

On systems with Rubin+ (SM_107+) GPUs, `memptr` may be aligned to 256 instead of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce). In such a case the `size` + `memptr` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) cannot be larger than the size of the than the size of the multicast object. The next available mcOffset for the next bind will be mcOffset + size + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9)

Also note that the ability to accept a `memptr` that is not aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce) is limited by HW resources and may result in error [CUDA_ERROR_MULTICAST_RESOURCE_FULL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ad60293ae96e3bf5c6ba18d7bc054c278)

The memory allocation must have beeen created on one of the devices that was added to the multicast team via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). Externally shareable as well as imported multicast objects can be bound only to externally shareable memory. Note that this call will return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`] if there are insufficient resources required to perform the bind. This call may also return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_SYSTEM_NOT_READY`] if the necessary system software is not initialized or running.

This call may fail if the devices added via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d) do not belong to the same clique.

This call may return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_STATE`] if the system configuration is in an illegal state. In such cases, to continue using multicast, verify that the system configuration is in a valid state and all required driver daemons are running properly.

mcOffset.doc: Offset into multicast va range for attachment.

memptr.doc: Virtual address of the memory allocation.

size.doc: Size of memory that will be bound to the multicast object.

flags.doc: Flags for future use, must be zero now.

cuMulticastBindAddr_v2.signature: CUresult cuMulticastBindAddr_v2(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle mcHandle, CUdevice dev, size_t mcOffset, CUdeviceptr memptr, size_t size, unsigned long long flags)
cuMulticastBindAddr_v2.doc:
Bind a memory allocation represented by a virtual address to a multicast object.

Binds a memory allocation specified by its mapped address `memptr` to a multicast object represented by `mcHandle`. The binding will be applicable for the device `dev`. The memory must have been allocated via [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) or ::cudaMallocAsync. The intended `size` of the bind, the offset in the multicast range `mcOffset` and `memptr` must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). For best performance however, `size`, `mcOffset` and `memptr` should be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce).

The `size` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` cannot be larger than the total size of the multicast object.

On systems with Rubin+ (SM_107+) GPUs, `memptr` may be aligned to 256 instead of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce). In such a case the `size` + `memptr` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) cannot be larger than the size of the than the size of the multicast object. The next available mcOffset for the next bind will be mcOffset + size + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9)

Also note that the ability to accept a `memptr` that is not aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce) is limited by HW resources and may result in error [CUDA_ERROR_MULTICAST_RESOURCE_FULL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ad60293ae96e3bf5c6ba18d7bc054c278)

For device memory, i.e., type [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_DEVICE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eaa4409aa6b414995d628a320eafbbbb6e), the memory allocation must have been created on the device specified by `dev`. For host NUMA memory, i.e., type [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eab61a1d3409ed83a43b5706cc004ac861), the memory allocation must have been created on the CPU NUMA node closest to `dev`. That is, the value returned when querying [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_HOST_NUMA_ID](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3a2583f8184b09441b3c83b1bee7849556) for `dev`, must be the CPU NUMA node where the memory was allocated. In both cases, the device named by `dev` must have been added to the multicast team via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). Externally shareable as well as imported multicast objects can be bound only to externally shareable memory. Note that this call will return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`] if there are insufficient resources required to perform the bind. This call may also return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_SYSTEM_NOT_READY`] if the necessary system software is not initialized or running.

This call may fail if the devices added via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d) do not belong to the same clique.

This call may return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_STATE`] if the system configuration is in an illegal state. In such cases, to continue using multicast, verify that the system configuration is in a valid state and all required driver daemons are running properly.

dev.doc: The device that for which the multicast memory binding will be applicable.

mcOffset.doc: Offset into multicast va range for attachment.

memptr.doc: Virtual address of the memory allocation.

size.doc: Size of memory that will be bound to the multicast object.

flags.doc: Flags for future use, must be zero now.

cuMulticastBindMem.signature: CUresult cuMulticastBindMem(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle mcHandle, size_t mcOffset, CUmemGenericAllocationHandle memHandle, size_t memOffset, size_t size, unsigned long long flags)
cuMulticastBindMem.doc:
Bind a memory allocation represented by a handle to a multicast object.

Binds a memory allocation specified by `memHandle` and created via [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) to a multicast object represented by `mcHandle` and created via [cuMulticastCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1gad4413361f466d4ed86a93d8c309c0242). The intended `size` of the bind, the offset in the multicast range `mcOffset` as well as the offset in the memory `memOffset` must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). For best performance however, `size`, `mcOffset` and `memOffset` should be aligned to the granularity of the memory allocation(see ::cuMemGetAllocationGranularity) or to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce).

The `size` + `memOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the multicast object.

On systems with Rubin+ (SM_107+) GPUs, `memOffset` may be aligned to 256 instead of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce). In such a case the `size` + `memOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) cannot be larger than the size of the than the size of the multicast object. The next available mcOffset for the next bind will be mcOffset + size + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9).

Also note that the ability to accept a `memOffset` that is not aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce) is limited by HW resources and may result in error [CUDA_ERROR_MULTICAST_RESOURCE_FULL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ad60293ae96e3bf5c6ba18d7bc054c278)

The memory allocation must have beeen created on one of the devices that was added to the multicast team via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). Externally shareable as well as imported multicast objects can be bound only to externally shareable memory. Note that this call will return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`] if there are insufficient resources required to perform the bind. This call may also return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_SYSTEM_NOT_READY`] if the necessary system software is not initialized or running.

This call may fail if the devices added via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d) do not belong to the same clique.

This call may return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_STATE`] if the system configuration is in an illegal state. In such cases, to continue using multicast, verify that the system configuration is in a valid state and all required driver daemons are running properly.

mcOffset.doc: Offset into the multicast object for attachment.

memOffset.doc: Offset into the memory for attachment.

size.doc: Size of the memory that will be bound to the multicast object.

flags.doc: Flags for future use, must be zero for now.

cuMulticastBindMem_v2.signature: CUresult cuMulticastBindMem_v2(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle mcHandle, CUdevice dev, size_t mcOffset, CUmemGenericAllocationHandle memHandle, size_t memOffset, size_t size, unsigned long long flags)
cuMulticastBindMem_v2.doc:
Bind a memory allocation represented by a handle to a multicast object.

Binds a memory allocation specified by `memHandle` and created via [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) to a multicast object represented by `mcHandle` and created via [cuMulticastCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1gad4413361f466d4ed86a93d8c309c0242). The binding will be applicable for the device `dev`. The intended `size` of the bind, the offset in the multicast range `mcOffset` as well as the offset in the memory `memOffset` must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). For best performance however, `size`, `mcOffset` and `memOffset` should be aligned to the granularity of the memory allocation(see ::cuMemGetAllocationGranularity) or to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce).

The `size` + `memOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the multicast object.

On systems with Rubin+ (SM_107+) GPUs, `memOffset` may be aligned to 256 instead of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce). In such a case the `size` + `memOffset` cannot be larger than the size of the allocated memory. Similarly the `size` + `mcOffset` + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) cannot be larger than the size of the than the size of the multicast object. The next available mcOffset for the next bind will be mcOffset + size + the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9).

Also note that the ability to accept a `memOffset` that is not aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9) or [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce) is limited by HW resources and may result in error [CUDA_ERROR_MULTICAST_RESOURCE_FULL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ad60293ae96e3bf5c6ba18d7bc054c278)

The memory allocation must have beeen created on one of the devices that was added to the multicast team via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). For device memory, i.e., type [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_DEVICE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eaa4409aa6b414995d628a320eafbbbb6e), the memory allocation must have been created on the device specified by `dev`. For host NUMA memory, i.e., type [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eab61a1d3409ed83a43b5706cc004ac861), the memory allocation must have been created on the CPU NUMA node closest to `dev`. That is, the value returned when querying [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_HOST_NUMA_ID](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3a2583f8184b09441b3c83b1bee7849556) for `dev`, must be the CPU NUMA node where the memory was allocated. In both cases, the device named by `dev` must have been added to the multicast team via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). Externally shareable as well as imported multicast objects can be bound only to externally shareable memory. Note that this call will return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`] if there are insufficient resources required to perform the bind. This call may also return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_SYSTEM_NOT_READY`] if the necessary system software is not initialized or running.

This call may fail if the devices added via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d) do not belong to the same clique.

This call may return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_STATE`] if the system configuration is in an illegal state. In such cases, to continue using multicast, verify that the system configuration is in a valid state and all required driver daemons are running properly.

mcOffset.doc: Offset into the multicast object for attachment.

memOffset.doc: Offset into the memory for attachment.

size.doc: Size of the memory that will be bound to the multicast object.

flags.doc: Flags for future use, must be zero for now.

cuMulticastCreate.doc:
Create a generic allocation handle representing a multicast object described by the given properties.

This creates a multicast object as described by `prop`. The number of participating devices is specified by [CUmulticastObjectProp::numDevices](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmulticastObjectProp__v1.html#structcumulticastobjectprop__v1_1ae5d44c9262847a6c74e4ae37acdc7478). Devices can be added to the multicast object via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d). All participating devices must be added to the multicast object before memory can be bound to it. Memory is bound to the multicast object via [cuMulticastBindMem](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1gacadf88b616a3f766f6279288e435a4bb), [cuMulticastBindMem_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga0e0ed2e81af121bdcbb54e1a9c4e63a5), [cuMulticastBindAddr](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga07c8cf1d3bf1d04a2d1867f09647b03f), or [cuMulticastBindAddr_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga0eb82d8911bf179ae239d522da049bed). and can be unbound via [cuMulticastUnbind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga424b4563760cc5dab52ee9a8d28656ac). The total amount of memory that can be bound per device is specified by :[CUmulticastObjectProp::size](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmulticastObjectProp__v1.html#structcumulticastobjectprop__v1_1aa45dfd715e2e442fcc7e43f5ce2f8a46). This size must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). For best performance however, the size should be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_RECOMMENDED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378adfff741c8fa1dd2f96e584939b0c53ce).

After all participating devices have been added, multicast objects can also be mapped to a device’s virtual address space using the virtual memory management APIs (see [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) and [cuMemSetAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1b6b12b10e8324bf462ecab4e7ef30e1)). Multicast objects can also be shared with other processes by requesting a shareable handle via [cuMemExportToShareableHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga633f273b155815f23c1d70e7d9384c56). Note that the desired types of shareable handles must be specified in the bitmask [CUmulticastObjectProp::handleTypes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmulticastObjectProp__v1.html#structcumulticastobjectprop__v1_1a705cc17eda91d960e96982f2fda52d55). Multicast objects can be released using the virtual memory management API [cuMemRelease](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga3014f0759f43a8d82db951b8e4b91d68).

prop.doc: Properties of the multicast object to create.

cuMulticastGetGranularity.signature: CUresult cuMulticastGetGranularity(size_t * granularity, const CUmulticastObjectProp * prop, CUmulticastGranularity_flags option)
cuMulticastGetGranularity.doc:
Calculates either the minimal or recommended granularity for multicast object.

Calculates either the minimal or recommended granularity for a given set of multicast object properties and returns it in granularity. This granularity can be used as a multiple for size, bind offsets and address mappings of the multicast object.

cuMulticastUnbind.signature: CUresult cuMulticastUnbind(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle mcHandle, CUdevice dev, size_t mcOffset, size_t size)
cuMulticastUnbind.doc:
Unbind any memory allocations bound to a multicast object at a given offset and upto a given size.

Unbinds any memory allocations hosted on `dev` and bound to a multicast object at `mcOffset` and upto a given `size`. The intended `size` of the unbind and the offset in the multicast range ( `mcOffset` ) must be a multiple of the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) flag [CU_MULTICAST_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggacdeff171670a788001418262a0f88378a790ecc4b1f2c2f6e2c9bc21b230872a9). The `size` + `mcOffset` cannot be larger than the total size of the multicast object.

dev.doc: Device that hosts the memory allocation.

size.doc: Desired size to unbind.

cuOccupancyAvailableDynamicSMemPerBlock.signature: CUresult cuOccupancyAvailableDynamicSMemPerBlock(size_t * dynamicSmemSize, CUfunction func, int numBlocks, int blockSize)
cuOccupancyAvailableDynamicSMemPerBlock.doc:
Returns dynamic shared memory available per block when launching `numBlocks` blocks on SM.

Returns in `*dynamicSmemSize` the maximum size of dynamic shared memory to allow `numBlocks` blocks per SM.

Note that the API can also be used with context-less kernel [CUkernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga612028921e5736db673e4307589989ed) by querying the handle using [cuLibraryGetKernel()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga15336d865f5abd63e3dc6004d5bc037a) and then passing it to the API by casting to [CUfunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaba6128b948022f495706d93bc2cea9c8). Here, the context to use for calculations will be the current context.

func.doc: Kernel function for which occupancy is calculated.

numBlocks.doc: Number of blocks to fit on SM.

cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiproces.signature: CUresult cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(int * numBlocks, CUfunction func, int blockSize, size_t dynamicSMemSize)
cuOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiproces.doc:
Returns occupancy of a function.

Returns in `*numBlocks` the number of the maximum active blocks per streaming multiprocessor.

Note that the API can also be used with context-less kernel [CUkernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga612028921e5736db673e4307589989ed) by querying the handle using [cuLibraryGetKernel()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga15336d865f5abd63e3dc6004d5bc037a) and then passing it to the API by casting to [CUfunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaba6128b948022f495706d93bc2cea9c8). Here, the context to use for calculations will be the current context.

cuOccupancyMaxActiveClusters.signature: CUresult cuOccupancyMaxActiveClusters(int * numClusters, CUfunction func, const CUlaunchConfig * config)
cuOccupancyMaxActiveClusters.doc:
Given the kernel function (`func`) and launch configuration (`config`), return the maximum number of clusters that could co-exist on the target device in `*numClusters`.

If the function has required cluster size already set (see ::cudaFuncGetAttributes / [cuFuncGetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__EXEC.html#group__cuda__exec_1ga5e92a1b0d8d1b82cb00dcfb2de15961b)), the cluster size from config must either be unspecified or match the required size. Without required sizes, the cluster size must be specified in config, else the function will return an error.

Note that various attributes of the kernel function may affect occupancy calculation. Runtime environment may affect how the hardware schedules the clusters, so the calculated occupancy is not guaranteed to be achievable.

Note that the API can also be used with context-less kernel [CUkernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga612028921e5736db673e4307589989ed) by querying the handle using [cuLibraryGetKernel()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga15336d865f5abd63e3dc6004d5bc037a) and then passing it to the API by casting to [CUfunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaba6128b948022f495706d93bc2cea9c8). Here, the context to use for calculations will either be taken from the specified stream `config->hStream` or the current context in case of NULL stream.

numClusters.doc: Returned maximum number of clusters that could co-exist on the target device.

func.doc: Kernel function for which maximum number of clusters are calculated.

config.doc: Launch configuration for the given kernel function.

cuOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize.signature: CUresult cuOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize(int * minGridSize, int * blockSize, CUfunction func, CUoccupancyB2DSize blockSizeToDynamicSMemSize, size_t dynamicSMemSize, int blockSizeLimit)
cuOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize.doc:
Suggest a launch configuration with reasonable occupancy.

Returns in `*blockSize` a reasonable block size that can achieve the maximum occupancy (or, the maximum number of active warps with the fewest blocks per multiprocessor), and in `*minGridSize` the minimum grid size to achieve the maximum occupancy.

If `blockSizeLimit` is 0, the configurator will use the maximum block size permitted by the device / function instead.

If per-block dynamic shared memory allocation is not needed, the user should leave both `blockSizeToDynamicSMemSize` and `dynamicSMemSize` as 0.

If per-block dynamic shared memory allocation is needed, then if the dynamic shared memory size is constant regardless of block size, the size should be passed through `dynamicSMemSize`, and `blockSizeToDynamicSMemSize` should be NULL.

Otherwise, if the per-block dynamic shared memory size varies with different block sizes, the user needs to provide a unary function through `blockSizeToDynamicSMemSize` that computes the dynamic shared memory needed by `func` for any given block size. `dynamicSMemSize` is ignored. An example signature is:

Note that the API can also be used with context-less kernel [CUkernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga612028921e5736db673e4307589989ed) by querying the handle using [cuLibraryGetKernel()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga15336d865f5abd63e3dc6004d5bc037a) and then passing it to the API by casting to [CUfunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaba6128b948022f495706d93bc2cea9c8). Here, the context to use for calculations will be the current context.

minGridSize.doc: Returned minimum grid size needed to achieve the maximum occupancy.

blockSize.doc: Returned maximum block size that can achieve the maximum occupancy.

func.doc: Kernel for which launch configuration is calculated.

blockSizeToDynamicSMemSize.doc: A function that calculates how much per-block dynamic shared memory `func` uses based on the block size.

dynamicSMemSize.doc: Dynamic shared memory usage intended, in bytes.

blockSizeLimit.doc: The maximum block size `func` is designed to handle.

cuOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSizeWithFlag.doc:
Suggest a launch configuration with reasonable occupancy.

An extended version of [cuOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__OCCUPANCY.html#group__cuda__occupancy_1gaf179c4ab78962a8468e41c3f57851f03). The `Flags` parameter controls how special cases are handled. The valid flags are:

cuOccupancyMaxPotentialClusterSize.signature: CUresult cuOccupancyMaxPotentialClusterSize(int * clusterSize, CUfunction func, const CUlaunchConfig * config)
cuOccupancyMaxPotentialClusterSize.doc:
Given the kernel function (`func`) and launch configuration (`config`), return the maximum cluster size in `*clusterSize`.

The cluster dimensions in `config` are ignored. If func has a required cluster size set (see ::cudaFuncGetAttributes / [cuFuncGetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__EXEC.html#group__cuda__exec_1ga5e92a1b0d8d1b82cb00dcfb2de15961b)),`*clusterSize` will reflect the required cluster size.

By default this function will always return a value that’s portable on future hardware. A higher value may be returned if the kernel function allows non-portable cluster sizes.

This function will respect the compile time launch bounds.

Note that the API can also be used with context-less kernel [CUkernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga612028921e5736db673e4307589989ed) by querying the handle using [cuLibraryGetKernel()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LIBRARY.html#group__cuda__library_1ga15336d865f5abd63e3dc6004d5bc037a) and then passing it to the API by casting to [CUfunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaba6128b948022f495706d93bc2cea9c8). Here, the context to use for calculations will either be taken from the specified stream `config->hStream` or the current context in case of NULL stream.

clusterSize.doc: Returned maximum cluster size that can be launched for the given kernel function and launch configuration.

func.doc: Kernel function for which maximum cluster size is calculated.

config.doc: Launch configuration for the given kernel function.

The `deviceList` argument may be any of the following.

cuCtxDisablePeerAccess.doc:
Disables direct access to memory allocations in a peer context and unregisters any registered allocations.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_PEER_ACCESS_NOT_ENABLED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a5e985a1735204ae8455e9eec402d46c3) if direct peer access has not yet been enabled from `peerContext` to the current context.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aa484e9af32c1e9893ff21f0e0191a12d) if there is no current context, or if `peerContext` is not a valid context.

cuCtxEnablePeerAccess.signature: CUresult cuCtxEnablePeerAccess(CUcontext peerContext, unsigned int Flags)
cuCtxEnablePeerAccess.doc:
Enables direct access to memory allocations in a peer context.

If both the current context and `peerContext` are on devices which support unified addressing (as may be queried using [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_UNIFIED_ADDRESSING](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3adc11dd6d9f149a7bae32499f2b802c0d)) and same major compute capability, then on success all allocations from `peerContext` will immediately be accessible by the current context. See [Unified Addressing](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__UNIFIED.html#group__cuda__unified) for additional details.

Note that access granted by this call is unidirectional and that in order to access memory from the current context in `peerContext`, a separate symmetric call to [cuCtxEnablePeerAccess()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__PEER__ACCESS.html#group__cuda__peer__access_1ga0889ec6728e61c05ed359551d67b3f5a) is required.

Note that there are both device-wide and system-wide limitations per system configuration, as noted in the CUDA Programming Guide under the section “Peer-to-Peer Memory Access”.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_PEER_ACCESS_UNSUPPORTED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ad60abcaa3f2710f961db8c383bb95cae) if [cuDeviceCanAccessPeer()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__PEER__ACCESS.html#group__cuda__peer__access_1ga496bdaae1f632ebfb695b99d2c40f19e) indicates that the [CUdevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga41ca2a24a242b36ef2ca77330b5fb72a) of the current context cannot directly access memory from the [CUdevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga41ca2a24a242b36ef2ca77330b5fb72a) of `peerContext`.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_PEER_ACCESS_ALREADY_ENABLED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a47c18606be796573aa2957402fa89a9c) if direct access of `peerContext` from the current context has already been enabled.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_TOO_MANY_PEERS](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a168ef870793a31ef4cdd7cb6e279b34a) if direct peer access is not possible because hardware resources required for peer access have been exhausted.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aa484e9af32c1e9893ff21f0e0191a12d) if there is no current context, `peerContext` is not a valid context, or if the current context is `peerContext`.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) if `Flags` is not 0.

peerContext.doc: Peer context to enable direct access to from the current context.

Flags.doc: Reserved for future use and must be set to 0.

cuDeviceCanAccessPeer.signature: CUresult cuDeviceCanAccessPeer(int * canAccessPeer, CUdevice dev, CUdevice peerDev)
cuDeviceCanAccessPeer.doc:
Queries if a device may directly access a peer device’s memory.

Returns in `*canAccessPeer` a value of 1 if contexts on `dev` are capable of directly accessing memory from contexts on `peerDev` and 0 otherwise. If direct access of `peerDev` from `dev` is possible, then access may be enabled on two specific contexts by calling [cuCtxEnablePeerAccess()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__PEER__ACCESS.html#group__cuda__peer__access_1ga0889ec6728e61c05ed359551d67b3f5a).

dev.doc: Device from which allocations on `peerDev` are to be directly accessed.

peerDev.doc: Device on which the allocations to be directly accessed by `dev` reside.

cuDeviceGetP2PAtomicCapabilities.signature: CUresult cuDeviceGetP2PAtomicCapabilities(unsigned int * capabilities, const CUatomicOperation * operations, unsigned int count, CUdevice srcDevice, CUdevice dstDevice)
cuDeviceGetP2PAtomicCapabilities.doc:
Queries details about atomic operations supported between two devices.

Returns in `*capabilities` the details about requested atomic `*operations` over the link between `srcDevice` and `dstDevice`. The allocated size of `*operations` and `*capabilities` must be `count`.

For each [CUatomicOperation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gafd7012de0abfe50cee089f3f00d6dcf3) in `*operations`, the corresponding result in `*capabilities` will be a bitmask indicating which of [CUatomicOperationCapability](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gaf8fbc0f84fd6461c5611b3935b26e22c) the link supports natively.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_DEVICE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a6f047e7215788ca96c81af92a04bfb6c) if `srcDevice` or `dstDevice` are not valid or if they represent the same device.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) if `*capabilities` or `*operations` is NULL, if `count` is 0, or if any of `*operations` is not valid.

capabilities.doc: Returned capability details of each requested operation.

count.doc: Count of requested operations and size of capabilities.

srcDevice.doc: The source device of the target link.

dstDevice.doc: The destination device of the target link.

cuDeviceGetP2PAttribute.signature: CUresult cuDeviceGetP2PAttribute(int * value, CUdevice_P2PAttribute attrib, CUdevice srcDevice, CUdevice dstDevice)
cuDeviceGetP2PAttribute.doc:
Queries attributes of the link between two devices.

Returns in `*value` the value of the requested attribute `attrib` of the link between `srcDevice` and `dstDevice`. The supported attributes are:

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_DEVICE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a6f047e7215788ca96c81af92a04bfb6c) if `srcDevice` or `dstDevice` are not valid or if they represent the same device.

Returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) if `attrib` is not valid or if `value` is a null pointer.

value.doc: Returned value of the requested attribute.

attrib.doc: The requested attribute of the link between `srcDevice` and `dstDevice`.

srcDevice.doc: The source device of the target link.

dstDevice.doc: The destination device of the target link.

cuDevicePrimaryCtxGetState.signature: CUresult cuDevicePrimaryCtxGetState(CUdevice dev, unsigned int * flags, int * active)
cuDevicePrimaryCtxGetState.doc:
Get the state of the primary context.

Returns in `*flags` the flags for the primary context of `dev`, and in `*active` whether it is active. See cuDevicePrimaryCtxSetFlags for flag values.

dev.doc: Device to get primary context flags for.

flags.doc: Pointer to store flags.

active.doc: Pointer to store context state; 0 = inactive, 1 = active.

cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease.doc:
Release the primary context on the GPU.

Releases the primary context interop on the device. A retained context should always be released once the user is done using it. The context is automatically reset once the last reference to it is released. This behavior is different when the primary context was retained by the CUDA runtime from CUDA 4.0 and earlier. In this case, the primary context remains always active.

Releasing a primary context that has not been previously retained will fail with [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aa484e9af32c1e9893ff21f0e0191a12d).

Please note that unlike cuCtxDestroy() this method does not pop the context from stack in any circumstances.

cuDevicePrimaryCtxReset.doc:
Destroy all allocations and reset all state on the primary context.

Explicitly destroys and cleans up all resources associated with the current device in the current process.

Note that it is responsibility of the calling function to ensure that no other module in the process is using the device any more. For that reason it is recommended to use cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease() in most cases. However it is safe for other modules to call cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease() even after resetting the device. Resetting the primary context does not release it, an application that has retained the primary context should explicitly release its usage.

cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain.doc:
Retain the primary context on the GPU.

Retains the primary context on the device. Once the user successfully retains the primary context, the primary context will be active and available to the user until the user releases it with cuDevicePrimaryCtxRelease() or resets it with cuDevicePrimaryCtxReset(). Unlike cuCtxCreate() the newly retained context is not pushed onto the stack.

Retaining the primary context for the first time will fail with [CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ac5a6ab0245179d297f1fa56ed0097183) if the compute mode of the device is [CU_COMPUTEMODE_PROHIBITED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga637aab2eadb52e1c1c048b8bad9592d1adb8a226241187db3b1f41999bb70eb47). The function [cuDeviceGetAttribute()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__DEVICE.html#group__cuda__device_1ga9c3e1414f0ad901d3278a4d6645fc266) can be used with [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_COMPUTE_MODE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3af6669a29a6d42968047747cbfc501289) to determine the compute mode of the device. The *nvidia-smi* tool can be used to set the compute mode for devices. Documentation for *nvidia-smi* can be obtained by passing a -h option to it.

Please note that the primary context always supports pinned allocations. Other flags can be specified by cuDevicePrimaryCtxSetFlags().

pctx.doc: Returned context handle of the new context.

dev.doc: Device for which primary context is requested.

cuDevicePrimaryCtxSetFlags.signature: CUresult cuDevicePrimaryCtxSetFlags(CUdevice dev, unsigned int flags)
cuDevicePrimaryCtxSetFlags.doc:
Set flags for the primary context.

Sets the flags for the primary context on the device overwriting previously set ones.
