cuVDPAUCtxCreate.signature: CUresult cuVDPAUCtxCreate(CUcontext * pCtx, unsigned int flags, CUdevice device, VdpDevice vdpDevice, VdpGetProcAddress * vdpGetProcAddress)
cuVDPAUCtxCreate.doc:
Create a CUDA context for interoperability with VDPAU.

Creates a new CUDA context, initializes VDPAU interoperability, and associates the CUDA context with the calling thread. It must be called before performing any other VDPAU interoperability operations. It may fail if the needed VDPAU driver facilities are not available. For usage of the `flags` parameter, see cuCtxCreate().

flags.doc: Options for CUDA context creation.

device.doc: Device on which to create the context.

cuVDPAUGetDevice.signature: CUresult cuVDPAUGetDevice(CUdevice * pDevice, VdpDevice vdpDevice, VdpGetProcAddress * vdpGetProcAddress)
cuVDPAUGetDevice.doc:
Gets the CUDA device associated with a VDPAU device.

Returns in `*pDevice` the CUDA device associated with a `vdpDevice`, if applicable.

cuDriverGetVersion.doc:
Returns the latest CUDA version supported by driver.

Returns in `*driverVersion` the version of CUDA supported by the driver. The version is returned as (1000 \* major + 10 \* minor). For example, CUDA 9.2 would be represented by 9020.

This function automatically returns [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) if `driverVersion` is NULL.

cuMemAddressFree.doc:
Free an address range reservation.

Frees a virtual address range reserved by cuMemAddressReserve. The size must match what was given to memAddressReserve and the ptr given must match what was returned from memAddressReserve.

ptr.doc: Starting address of the virtual address range to free.

size.doc: Size of the virtual address region to free.

cuMemAddressReserve.signature: CUresult cuMemAddressReserve(CUdeviceptr * ptr, size_t size, size_t alignment, CUdeviceptr addr, unsigned long long flags)
cuMemAddressReserve.doc:
Allocate an address range reservation.

Reserves a virtual address range based on the given parameters, giving the starting address of the range in `ptr`. This API requires a system that supports UVA. The size and address parameters must be a multiple of the host page size and the alignment must be a power of two or zero for default alignment. If `addr` is 0, then the driver chooses the address at which to place the start of the reservation whereas when it is non-zero then the driver treats it as a hint about where to place the reservation.

ptr.doc: Resulting pointer to start of virtual address range allocated.

size.doc: Size of the reserved virtual address range requested.

alignment.doc: Alignment of the reserved virtual address range requested.

addr.doc: Hint address for the start of the address range.

flags.doc: Currently unused, must be zero.

cuMemCreate.signature: CUresult cuMemCreate(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle * handle, size_t size, const CUmemAllocationProp * prop, unsigned long long flags)
cuMemCreate.doc:
Create a CUDA memory handle representing a memory allocation of a given size described by the given properties.

This creates a memory allocation on the target device specified through the `prop` structure. The created allocation will not have any device or host mappings. The generic memory `handle` for the allocation can be mapped to the address space of calling process via [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56). This handle cannot be transmitted directly to other processes (see [cuMemExportToShareableHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga633f273b155815f23c1d70e7d9384c56)). On Windows, the caller must also pass an LPSECURITYATTRIBUTE in `prop` to be associated with this handle which limits or allows access to this handle for a recipient process (see [CUmemAllocationProp::win32HandleMetaData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemAllocationProp__v1.html#structcumemallocationprop__v1_1a542262ad88e1d00f02b306c641270168) for more). The `size` of this allocation must be a multiple of the value given via [cuMemGetAllocationGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga30ee906c2cf66a0347b3dfec3d7eb31a) with the [CU_MEM_ALLOC_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga3a202e4d32ae296db1af7efe75ce365dac74872d07341bb1ac24ccc4a1c9c2f56) flag. To create a CPU allocation that doesn’t target any specific NUMA nodes, applications must set [CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::type](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemAllocationProp__v1.html#structcumemallocationprop__v1_1a574c7287583cd07f23efc94d444087b1) to [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882ea46800776121a71c8dc2904518a21065a). ::CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::id is ignored for HOST allocations. HOST allocations are not IPC capable and [CUmemAllocationProp::requestedHandleTypes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemAllocationProp__v1.html#structcumemallocationprop__v1_1ae2e852e72e5d2053b771fbac49495efd) must be 0, any other value will result in [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb). To create a CPU allocation targeting a specific host NUMA node, applications must set [CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::type](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemAllocationProp__v1.html#structcumemallocationprop__v1_1a574c7287583cd07f23efc94d444087b1) to [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eab61a1d3409ed83a43b5706cc004ac861) and ::CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::id must specify the NUMA ID of the CPU. On systems where NUMA is not available ::CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::id must be set to 0. Specifying [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA_CURRENT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882ea55b82116b2124510a1a3b6c52096daaa) as the [CUmemLocation::type](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemLocation__v1.html#structcumemlocation__v1_1aa34fc29f2a55d501f00f912d92152d1b) will result in [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb). Specifying [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_DEVICE_LOCALITY_DOMAIN](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882ea178b51df01f1de90894a00ce1c131f25) as the [CUmemLocation::type](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemLocation__v1.html#structcumemlocation__v1_1aa34fc29f2a55d501f00f912d92152d1b) will localize the allocation to the specified locality domain. ::CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::localized.deviceId must specify the device ID. ::CUmemAllocationProp::CUmemLocation::localized.localityDomainId must specify the locality domain ID. The locality domain ID must be a valid locality domain ID for the specified device. See also [cuDeviceGetAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__DEVICE.html#group__cuda__device_1ga9c3e1414f0ad901d3278a4d6645fc266) with the attribute [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_LOCALITY_DOMAIN_COUNT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3ac2f9f334188d368fad3bd94922c718a6).

Applications that intend to use [CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9ae38a182adb450da6c1a3f29cd5dca032) based memory sharing must ensure: (1) `nvidia-caps-imex-channels` character device is created by the driver and is listed under /proc/devices (2) have at least one IMEX channel file accessible by the user launching the application.

When exporter and importer CUDA processes have been granted access to the same IMEX channel, they can securely share memory.

The IMEX channel security model works on a per user basis. Which means all processes under a user can share memory if the user has access to a valid IMEX channel. When multi-user isolation is desired, a separate IMEX channel is required for each user.

These channel files exist in /dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channel\* and can be created using standard OS native calls like mknod on Linux. For example: To create channel0 with the major number from /proc/devices users can execute the following command: `mknod /dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channel0 c <major number> 0`

If [CUmemAllocationProp::allocFlags::usage](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemAllocationProp__v1.html#structcumemallocationprop__v1_1affdae8fc56d42a203bb8a7629df3ac51) contains [CU_MEM_CREATE_USAGE_TILE_POOL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gab445d91d9773d728b1a9962184c05799) flag then the memory allocation is intended only to be used as backing tile pool for sparse CUDA arrays and sparse CUDA mipmapped arrays. (see [cuMemMapArrayAsync](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga5dc41a62a9feb68f2e943b438c83e5ab)).

handle.doc: Value of handle returned. All operations on this allocation are to be performed using this handle.

size.doc: Size of the allocation requested.

prop.doc: Properties of the allocation to create.

flags.doc: flags for future use, must be zero now.

cuMemExportToShareableHandle.signature: CUresult cuMemExportToShareableHandle(void * shareableHandle, CUmemGenericAllocationHandle handle, CUmemAllocationHandleType handleType, unsigned long long flags)
cuMemExportToShareableHandle.doc:
Exports an allocation to a requested shareable handle type.

Given a CUDA memory handle, create a shareable memory allocation handle that can be used to share the memory with other processes. The recipient process can convert the shareable handle back into a CUDA memory handle using [cuMemImportFromShareableHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1577822cc83ea896b4892f2d69630463) and map it with [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56). The implementation of what this handle is and how it can be transferred is defined by the requested handle type in `handleType`

Once all shareable handles are closed and the allocation is released, the allocated memory referenced will be released back to the OS and uses of the CUDA handle afterward will lead to undefined behavior.

This API can also be used in conjunction with other APIs (e.g. Vulkan, OpenGL) that support importing memory from the shareable type.

shareableHandle.doc: Pointer to the location in which to store the requested handle type.

handle.doc: CUDA handle for the memory allocation.

handleType.doc: Type of shareable handle requested (defines type and size of the `shareableHandle` output parameter).

flags.doc: Reserved, must be zero.

cuMemGetAccess.signature: CUresult cuMemGetAccess(unsigned long long * flags, const CUmemLocation * location, CUdeviceptr ptr)
cuMemGetAccess.doc: Get the access `flags` set for the given `location` and `ptr`.

flags.doc: Flags set for this location.

location.doc: Location in which to check the flags for.

ptr.doc: Address in which to check the access flags for.

cuMemGetAllocationGranularity.signature: CUresult cuMemGetAllocationGranularity(size_t * granularity, const CUmemAllocationProp * prop, CUmemAllocationGranularity_flags option)
cuMemGetAllocationGranularity.doc:
Calculates either the minimal or recommended granularity.

Calculates either the minimal or recommended granularity for a given allocation specification and returns it in granularity. This granularity can be used as a multiple for alignment, size, or address mapping.

prop.doc: Property for which to determine the granularity for.

cuMemGetAllocationPropertiesFromHandle.doc: Retrieve the contents of the property structure defining properties for this handle.

prop.doc: Pointer to a properties structure which will hold the information about this handle.

handle.doc: Handle which to perform the query on.

cuMemImportFromShareableHandle.signature: CUresult cuMemImportFromShareableHandle(CUmemGenericAllocationHandle * handle, void * osHandle, CUmemAllocationHandleType shHandleType)
cuMemImportFromShareableHandle.doc:
Imports an allocation from a requested shareable handle type.

If the current process cannot support the memory described by this shareable handle, this API will error as [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a54756ae7ade0dfd09faeccb513dd831b).

If `shHandleType` is [CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9ae38a182adb450da6c1a3f29cd5dca032) and the importer process has not been granted access to the same IMEX channel as the exporter process, this API will error as [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae23d0197c490ec332a43e55b167968a3).

handle.doc: CUDA Memory handle for the memory allocation.

osHandle.doc: Shareable Handle representing the memory allocation that is to be imported.

shHandleType.doc: handle type of the exported handle [CUmemAllocationHandleType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9).

cuMemMap.signature: CUresult cuMemMap(CUdeviceptr ptr, size_t size, size_t offset, CUmemGenericAllocationHandle handle, unsigned long long flags)
cuMemMap.doc:
Maps an allocation handle to a reserved virtual address range.

Maps bytes of memory represented by `handle` starting from byte `offset` to `size` to address range [`addr`, `addr` + `size`]. This range must be an address reservation previously reserved with [cuMemAddressReserve](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gae489256c107df2a07ddf96d80c86cd9b), and `offset` + `size` must be less than the size of the memory allocation. Both `ptr`, `size`, and `offset` must be a multiple of the value given via [cuMemGetAllocationGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga30ee906c2cf66a0347b3dfec3d7eb31a) with the [CU_MEM_ALLOC_GRANULARITY_MINIMUM](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga3a202e4d32ae296db1af7efe75ce365dac74872d07341bb1ac24ccc4a1c9c2f56) flag. If `handle` represents a multicast object, `ptr`, `size` and `offset` must be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag ::CU_MULTICAST_MINIMUM_GRANULARITY. For best performance however, it is recommended that `ptr`, `size` and `offset` be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag ::CU_MULTICAST_RECOMMENDED_GRANULARITY.

When `handle` represents a multicast object, this call may fail if the devices added via [cuMulticastAddDevice](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga2df07b38ff506c519e9f799c5ddf7e5d) do not belong to the same clique.

When `handle` represents a multicast object, this call may return [`CUresult::CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_STATE`] if the system configuration is in an illegal state. In such cases, to continue using multicast, verify that the system configuration is in a valid state and all required driver daemons are running properly.

Please note calling [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) does not make the address accessible, the caller needs to update accessibility of a contiguous mapped VA range by calling [cuMemSetAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1b6b12b10e8324bf462ecab4e7ef30e1).

Once a recipient process obtains a shareable memory handle from [cuMemImportFromShareableHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1577822cc83ea896b4892f2d69630463), the process must use [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) to map the memory into its address ranges before setting accessibility with [cuMemSetAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1b6b12b10e8324bf462ecab4e7ef30e1).

[cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) can only create mappings on VA range reservations that are not currently mapped.

ptr.doc: Address where memory will be mapped.

size.doc: Size of the memory mapping.

- **offset** \u2013 **[in]** - Offset in.doc:
**offset** – **[in]** - Offset into the memory represented by

  * `handle` from which to start mapping
  * Note: currently must be zero.

flags.doc: flags for future use, must be zero now.

cuMemMapArrayAsync.signature: CUresult cuMemMapArrayAsync(CUarrayMapInfo * mapInfoList, unsigned int count, CUstream hStream)
cuMemMapArrayAsync.doc:
Maps or unmaps subregions of sparse CUDA arrays and sparse CUDA mipmapped arrays.

Performs map or unmap operations on subregions of sparse CUDA arrays and sparse CUDA mipmapped arrays. Each operation is specified by a CUarrayMapInfo entry in the `mapInfoList` array of size `count`. The structure CUarrayMapInfo is defined as follow:

where [CUarrayMapInfo::resourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a8cf3c7ba97c834ab8b0fcfb50fec578c) specifies the type of resource to be operated on. If [CUarrayMapInfo::resourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a8cf3c7ba97c834ab8b0fcfb50fec578c) is set to ::CUresourcetype::CU_RESOURCE_TYPE_ARRAY then CUarrayMapInfo::resource::array must be set to a valid sparse CUDA array handle. The CUDA array must be either a 2D, 2D layered or 3D CUDA array and must have been allocated using cuArrayCreate or cuArray3DCreate with the flag [CUDA_ARRAY3D_SPARSE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga8e13c9d3ef98d1f3dce95901a115abc2) or [CUDA_ARRAY3D_DEFERRED_MAPPING](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga854c29dbc47d04a4e42863cb87487d55). For CUDA arrays obtained using [cuMipmappedArrayGetLevel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html#group__cuda__mem_1ga82f276659f05be14820e99346b0f86b7), [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) will be returned. If [CUarrayMapInfo::resourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a8cf3c7ba97c834ab8b0fcfb50fec578c) is set to ::CUresourcetype::CU_RESOURCE_TYPE_MIPMAPPED_ARRAY then CUarrayMapInfo::resource::mipmap must be set to a valid sparse CUDA mipmapped array handle. The CUDA mipmapped array must be either a 2D, 2D layered or 3D CUDA mipmapped array and must have been allocated using [cuMipmappedArrayCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html#group__cuda__mem_1gaa5d2e311c7f9b0bc6d130af824a40bd3) with the flag [CUDA_ARRAY3D_SPARSE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga8e13c9d3ef98d1f3dce95901a115abc2) or [CUDA_ARRAY3D_DEFERRED_MAPPING](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga854c29dbc47d04a4e42863cb87487d55).

[CUarrayMapInfo::subresourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a7a2fe272bd8e44af2386f1c20c3d3c68) specifies the type of subresource within the resource. ::CUarraySparseSubresourceType_enum is defined as:

where ::CUarraySparseSubresourceType::CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_SUBRESOURCE_TYPE_SPARSE_LEVEL indicates a sparse-miplevel which spans at least one tile in every dimension. The remaining miplevels which are too small to span at least one tile in any dimension constitute the mip tail region as indicated by ::CUarraySparseSubresourceType::CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_SUBRESOURCE_TYPE_MIPTAIL subresource type.

If [CUarrayMapInfo::subresourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a7a2fe272bd8e44af2386f1c20c3d3c68) is set to ::CUarraySparseSubresourceType::CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_SUBRESOURCE_TYPE_SPARSE_LEVEL then CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel struct must contain valid array subregion offsets and extents. The [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::offsetX](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1aefe372bb107f7bc89cfcca0a857b33d3), [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::offsetY](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a98a37a828dc2814543c410c01e93b6dd) and [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::offsetZ](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1ad5dd8de9c3bd4c486a951c2784eb1c56) must specify valid X, Y and Z offsets respectively. The [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::extentWidth](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a50dd4e7049b30f74a5edfd393824f7f8), [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::extentHeight](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1acee9af385a8d55412462af044e2014f2) and [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::extentDepth](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1aace61d37825a0eabdd76649628e38e56) must specify valid width, height and depth extents respectively. These offsets and extents must be aligned to the corresponding tile dimension. For CUDA mipmapped arrays [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::level](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1aa8236fa42f04cd67abd14cb1ef0fca86) must specify a valid mip level index. Otherwise, must be zero. For layered CUDA arrays and layered CUDA mipmapped arrays [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::layer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a843b7856a03e69ad18eec27ccb40b222) must specify a valid layer index. Otherwise, must be zero. [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::offsetZ](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1ad5dd8de9c3bd4c486a951c2784eb1c56) must be zero and [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::sparseLevel::extentDepth](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1aace61d37825a0eabdd76649628e38e56) must be set to 1 for 2D and 2D layered CUDA arrays and CUDA mipmapped arrays. Tile extents can be obtained by calling [cuArrayGetSparseProperties](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html#group__cuda__mem_1gaf74df88a07404ee051f0e5b36647d8c7) and [cuMipmappedArrayGetSparseProperties](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html#group__cuda__mem_1ga55a16bd1780acb3cc94e8b88d5fe5e19)

If [CUarrayMapInfo::subresourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a7a2fe272bd8e44af2386f1c20c3d3c68) is set to ::CUarraySparseSubresourceType::CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_SUBRESOURCE_TYPE_MIPTAIL then CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::miptail struct must contain valid mip tail offset in [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::miptail::offset](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a4aee5e358272af897aeaf8b44fd15bdb) and size in [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::miptail::size](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1abb22d0785912f6bd26802bbd6c31a7ec). Both, mip tail offset and mip tail size must be aligned to the tile size. For layered CUDA mipmapped arrays which don’t have the flag [CU_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES_SINGLE_MIPTAIL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga0dcf4ba7e64caa5c1aa4e88caa7f659a) set in [CUDA_ARRAY_SPARSE_PROPERTIES::flags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUDA__ARRAY__SPARSE__PROPERTIES__v1.html#structcuda__array__sparse__properties__v1_1a0e842bb64091fa47809112c700cb5f0a) as returned by [cuMipmappedArrayGetSparseProperties](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html#group__cuda__mem_1ga55a16bd1780acb3cc94e8b88d5fe5e19), [CUarrayMapInfo::subresource::miptail::layer](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a843b7856a03e69ad18eec27ccb40b222) must specify a valid layer index. Otherwise, must be zero.

If CUarrayMapInfo::resource::array or CUarrayMapInfo::resource::mipmap was created with [CUDA_ARRAY3D_DEFERRED_MAPPING](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga854c29dbc47d04a4e42863cb87487d55) flag set the [CUarrayMapInfo::subresourceType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a7a2fe272bd8e44af2386f1c20c3d3c68) and the contents of CUarrayMapInfo::subresource will be ignored.

[CUarrayMapInfo::memOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1add139e9655407264f2aeb812cec0f19e) specifies the type of operation. [CUmemOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gae7469bd2e035fc9c937e84490fdcd349) is defined as:

If [CUarrayMapInfo::memOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1add139e9655407264f2aeb812cec0f19e) is set to ::CUmemOperationType::CU_MEM_OPERATION_TYPE_UNMAP then an unmapping operation is performed. CUarrayMapInfo::memHandle must be NULL.

[CUarrayMapInfo::deviceBitMask](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1af2d14f719018cc1daa786f7fd0652c2c) specifies the list of devices that must map or unmap physical memory. Currently, this mask must have exactly one bit set, and the corresponding device must match the device associated with the stream. If [CUarrayMapInfo::memOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1add139e9655407264f2aeb812cec0f19e) is set to ::CUmemOperationType::CU_MEM_OPERATION_TYPE_MAP, the device must also match the device associated with the tile pool memory allocation as specified by CUarrayMapInfo::memHandle.

[CUarrayMapInfo::flags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1a2e36982c16390693a56807d0b8e6380f) and [CUarrayMapInfo::reserved](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUarrayMapInfo__v1.html#structcuarraymapinfo__v1_1acf7014dc4a157928de12563d0181ceba)[] are unused and must be set to zero.

count.doc: Count of CUarrayMapInfo in `mapInfoList`.

hStream.doc: Stream identifier for the stream to use for map or unmap operations.

cuMemRelease.doc:
Release a memory handle representing a memory allocation which was previously allocated through cuMemCreate.

Frees the memory that was allocated on a device through cuMemCreate.

The memory allocation will be freed when all outstanding mappings to the memory are unmapped and when all outstanding references to the handle (including it’s shareable counterparts) are also released. The generic memory handle can be freed when there are still outstanding mappings made with this handle. Each time a recipient process imports a shareable handle, it needs to pair it with [cuMemRelease](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga3014f0759f43a8d82db951b8e4b91d68) for the handle to be freed. If `handle` is not a valid handle the behavior is undefined.

cuMemRetainAllocationHandle.doc:
Given an address `addr`, returns the allocation handle of the backing memory allocation.

The handle is guaranteed to be the same handle value used to map the memory. If the address requested is not mapped, the function will fail. The returned handle must be released with corresponding number of calls to [cuMemRelease](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga3014f0759f43a8d82db951b8e4b91d68).

handle.doc: CUDA Memory handle for the backing memory allocation.

addr.doc: Memory address to query, that has been mapped previously.

cuMemSetAccess.signature: CUresult cuMemSetAccess(CUdeviceptr ptr, size_t size, const CUmemAccessDesc * desc, size_t count)
cuMemSetAccess.doc:
Set the access flags for each location specified in `desc` for the given virtual address range.

Given the virtual address range via `ptr` and `size`, and the locations in the array given by `desc` and `count`, set the access flags for the target locations. The range must be a fully mapped address range containing all allocations created by [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56) / [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c). Users cannot specify [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eab61a1d3409ed83a43b5706cc004ac861) accessibility for allocations created on with other location types. Note: When ::CUmemAccessDesc::CUmemLocation::type is [CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga75cfd5b9fa5c1c6ee2be2547bfbe882eab61a1d3409ed83a43b5706cc004ac861), ::CUmemAccessDesc::CUmemLocation::id is ignored. When setting the access flags for a virtual address range mapping a multicast object, `ptr` and `size` must be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag ::CU_MULTICAST_MINIMUM_GRANULARITY. For best performance however, it is recommended that `ptr` and `size` be aligned to the value returned by [cuMulticastGetGranularity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MULTICAST.html#group__cuda__multicast_1ga067a02ad98f4e01f149011f523fec547) with the flag ::CU_MULTICAST_RECOMMENDED_GRANULARITY.

ptr.doc: Starting address for the virtual address range.

size.doc: Length of the virtual address range.

- **desc** \u2013 **[in]** - Array of CU.doc:
**desc** – **[in]** - Array of CUmemAccessDesc that describe how to change the

  * mapping for each location specified.

count.doc: Number of CUmemAccessDesc in `desc`.

cuMemUnmap.doc:
Unmap the backing memory of a given address range.

The range must be the entire contiguous address range that was mapped to. In other words, [cuMemUnmap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gafb50aac00c848fd7087e858f59bf7e2a) cannot unmap a sub-range of an address range mapped by [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) / [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56). Any backing memory allocations will be freed if there are no existing mappings and there are no unreleased memory handles.

When [cuMemUnmap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gafb50aac00c848fd7087e858f59bf7e2a) returns successfully the address range is converted to an address reservation and can be used for a future calls to [cuMemMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gaff1d395423af5c5c75375516959dae56). Any new mapping to this virtual address will need to have access granted through [cuMemSetAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga1b6b12b10e8324bf462ecab4e7ef30e1), as all mappings start with no accessibility setup.

ptr.doc: Starting address for the virtual address range to unmap.

size.doc: Size of the virtual address range to unmap.

CUD3D10map_flags.doc: Flags to map or unmap a resource.

cuD3D10CtxCreate.signature: CUresult cuD3D10CtxCreate(CUcontext * pCtx, CUdevice * pCudaDevice, unsigned int Flags, ID3D10Device * pD3DDevice)
cuD3D10CtxCreate.doc: Create a CUDA context for interoperability with Direct3D 10.

This device must be among the devices returned when querying ::CU_D3D10_DEVICES_ALL from [cuD3D10GetDevices](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D10.html#group__cuda__d3d10_1gadcc33dea972d5b834f45a0acefe5fe77).

cuD3D10MapResources.signature: CUresult cuD3D10MapResources(unsigned int count, ID3D10Resource * * ppResources)
cuD3D10MapResources.doc:
Map Direct3D resources for access by CUDA.

Maps the `count` Direct3D resources in `ppResources` for access by CUDA.

The resources in `ppResources` may be accessed in CUDA kernels until they are unmapped. Direct3D should not access any resources while they are mapped by CUDA. If an application does so, the results are undefined.

This function provides the synchronization guarantee that any Direct3D calls issued before [cuD3D10MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d10__deprecated_1ga3f1c5c5c1e8c0b02af277075d260fa72) will complete before any CUDA kernels issued after [cuD3D10MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d10__deprecated_1ga3f1c5c5c1e8c0b02af277075d260fa72) begin.

If any of `ppResources` have not been registered for use with CUDA or if `ppResources` contains any duplicate entries, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If any of `ppResources` are presently mapped for access by CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_ALREADY_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a240bb253a699176d9f49ee2f2c91b61b) is returned.

count.doc: Number of resources to map for CUDA.

cuD3D10RegisterResource.signature: CUresult cuD3D10RegisterResource(ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int Flags)
cuD3D10RegisterResource.doc:
Register a Direct3D resource for access by CUDA.

Registers the Direct3D resource `pResource` for access by CUDA.

If this call is successful, then the application will be able to map and unmap this resource until it is unregistered through [cuD3D10UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d10__deprecated_1ga820664c48e2dbac37979a21c21d6561d). Also on success, this call will increase the internal reference count on `pResource`. This reference count will be decremented when this resource is unregistered through [cuD3D10UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D10__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d10__deprecated_1ga820664c48e2dbac37979a21c21d6561d).

This call is potentially high-overhead and should not be called every frame in interactive applications.

The type of `pResource` must be one of the following.

The `Flags` argument specifies the mechanism through which CUDA will access the Direct3D resource. The following values are allowed.

Not all Direct3D resources of the above types may be used for interoperability with CUDA. The following are some limitations.

If Direct3D interoperability is not initialized on this context then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aa484e9af32c1e9893ff21f0e0191a12d) is returned. If `pResource` is of incorrect type or is already registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` cannot be registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ac5a6ab0245179d297f1fa56ed0097183) is returned.

cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray.signature: CUresult cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray(CUarray * pArray, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int SubResource)
cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedArray.doc:
Get an array through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pArray` an array through which the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `SubResource` may be accessed. The value set in `pArray` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUD3D10register_flags::CU_D3D10_REGISTER_FLAGS_ARRAY`], then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped, then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

For usage requirements of the `SubResource` parameter, see cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer().

cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch.signature: CUresult cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch(size_t * pPitch, size_t * pPitchSlice, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int SubResource)
cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPitch.doc:
Get the pitch of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPitch` and `*pPitchSlice` the pitch and Z-slice pitch of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `SubResource`. The values set in `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

The pitch and Z-slice pitch values may be used to compute the location of a sample on a surface as follows.

For a 2D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

For a 3D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y**, **z** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**z\*** **slicePitch** + **y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

Both parameters `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` are optional and may be set to NULL.

If `pResource` is not of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture10 or one of its sub-types or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUD3D10register_flags::CU_D3D10_REGISTER_FLAGS_NONE`], then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

For usage requirements of the `SubResource` parameter, see cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer().

cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer.signature: CUresult cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer(CUdeviceptr * pDevPtr, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int SubResource)
cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer.doc:
Get a pointer through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pDevPtr` the base pointer of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `SubResource`. The value set in `pDevPtr` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUD3D10register_flags::CU_D3D10_REGISTER_FLAGS_NONE`], then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped, then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::ID3D10Buffer, then `SubResource` must be 0. If `pResource` is of any other type, then the value of `SubResource` must come from the subresource calculation in ::D3D10CalcSubResource().

cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedSize.signature: CUresult cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedSize(size_t * pSize, ID3D10Resource * pResource, unsigned int SubResource)
cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedSize.doc:
Get the size of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pSize` the size of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `SubResource`. The value set in `pSize` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUD3D10register_flags::CU_D3D10_REGISTER_FLAGS_NONE`], then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

For usage requirements of the `SubResource` parameter, see cuD3D10ResourceGetMappedPointer().

The resources in `ppResource` may be accessed in CUDA kernels until they are unmapped. Direct3D should not access any resources while they are mapped by CUDA. If an application does so the results are undefined.

This function provides the synchronization guarantee that any Direct3D calls issued before [cuD3D9MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d9__deprecated_1ga4dd775efbe77be0830dd552ca9d06415) will complete before any CUDA kernels issued after [cuD3D9MapResources()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d9__deprecated_1ga4dd775efbe77be0830dd552ca9d06415) begin.

If any of `ppResource` have not been registered for use with CUDA or if `ppResource` contains any duplicate entries, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. cuD3D9RegisterResource.signature: CUresult cuD3D9RegisterResource(IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int Flags)
cuD3D9RegisterResource.doc:
Register a Direct3D resource for access by CUDA.

Registers the Direct3D resource `pResource` for access by CUDA.

If this call is successful, then the application will be able to map and unmap this resource until it is unregistered through [cuD3D9UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d9__deprecated_1ga12e2ef50f8993a414d670a63773b6760). Also on success, this call will increase the internal reference count on `pResource`. This reference count will be decremented when this resource is unregistered through [cuD3D9UnregisterResource()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__D3D9__DEPRECATED.html#group__cuda__d3d9__deprecated_1ga12e2ef50f8993a414d670a63773b6760).

This call is potentially high-overhead and should not be called every frame in interactive applications.

The type of `pResource` must be one of the following.

The `Flags` argument specifies the mechanism through which CUDA will access the Direct3D resource. The following values are allowed.

Not all Direct3D resources of the above types may be used for interoperability with CUDA. The following are some limitations.

If Direct3D interoperability is not initialized on this context, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_CONTEXT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9aa484e9af32c1e9893ff21f0e0191a12d) is returned. If `pResource` is of incorrect type (e.g. is a non-stand-alone ::IDirect3DSurface9) or is already registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` cannot be registered then [CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ac5a6ab0245179d297f1fa56ed0097183) is returned.

pResource.doc: Resource to register for CUDA access.

cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray.signature: CUresult cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray(CUarray * pArray, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int Face, unsigned int Level)
cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedArray.doc:
Get an array through which to access a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pArray` an array through which the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource` which corresponds to `Face` and `Level` may be accessed. The value set in `pArray` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUd3d9register_flags::CU_D3D9_REGISTER_FLAGS_ARRAY`] then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

For usage requirements of `Face` and `Level` parameters, see cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer().

cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch.signature: CUresult cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch(size_t * pPitch, size_t * pPitchSlice, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int Face, unsigned int Level)
cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPitch.doc:
Get the pitch of a subresource of a Direct3D resource which has been mapped for access by CUDA.

Returns in `*pPitch` and `*pPitchSlice` the pitch and Z-slice pitch of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `Face` and `Level`. The values set in `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

The pitch and Z-slice pitch values may be used to compute the location of a sample on a surface as follows.

For a 2D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

For a 3D surface, the byte offset of the sample at position **x**, **y**, **z** from the base pointer of the surface is:

**z\*** **slicePitch** + **y** \* **pitch** + (**bytes per pixel**) \* **x**

Both parameters `pPitch` and `pPitchSlice` are optional and may be set to NULL.

If `pResource` is not of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture9 or one of its sub-types or if `pResource` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then ::cudaErrorInvalidResourceHandle is returned. If `pResource` was not registered with usage flags [`CUd3d9register_flags::CU_D3D9_REGISTER_FLAGS_NONE`], then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped for access by CUDA then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

For usage requirements of `Face` and `Level` parameters, see cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer().

cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer.signature: CUresult cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer(CUdeviceptr * pDevPtr, IDirect3DResource9 * pResource, unsigned int Face, unsigned int Level)
cuD3D9ResourceGetMappedPointer.doc:

Returns in `*pDevPtr` the base pointer of the subresource of the mapped Direct3D resource `pResource`, which corresponds to `Face` and `Level`. The value set in `pDevPtr` may change every time that `pResource` is mapped.

If `pResource` is not registered, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `pResource` is not mapped, then [CUDA_ERROR_NOT_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9ae098433b926c9afdb6b6bdf191629447) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::IDirect3DCubeTexture9, then `Face` must one of the values enumerated by type ::D3DCUBEMAP_FACES. For all other types `Face` must be 0. If `Face` is invalid, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) is returned.

If `pResource` is of type ::IDirect3DBaseTexture9, then `Level` must correspond to a valid mipmap level. At present only mipmap level 0 is supported. For all other types `Level` must be 0. If `Level` is invalid, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a90696c86fcee1f536a1ec7d25867feeb) is returned.

cuGLSetBufferObjectMapFlags.doc:

Sets the map flags for the buffer object specified by `buffer`.

Changes to `Flags` will take effect the next time `buffer` is mapped. The `Flags` argument may be any of the following:

If `buffer` has not been registered for use with CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a0fd2e63260c6317ba943af0f7e4b8d21) is returned. If `buffer` is presently mapped for access by CUDA, then [CUDA_ERROR_ALREADY_MAPPED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggac6c391505e117393cc2558fff6bfc2e9a240bb253a699176d9f49ee2f2c91b61b) is returned.

CUaccessPolicyWindow_v1.doc:
Specifies an access policy for a window, a contiguous extent of memory beginning at base_ptr and ending at base_ptr + num_bytes.

num_bytes is limited by [`CUdevice_attribute::CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_ACCESS_POLICY_WINDOW_SIZE`]. Partition into many segments and assign segments such that: sum of “hit segments” / window == approx. ratio. sum of “miss segments” / window == approx 1-ratio. Segments and ratio specifications are fitted to the capabilities of the architecture. Accesses in a hit segment apply the hitProp access policy. Accesses in a miss segment apply the missProp access policy.

For possible values see [CUdevSmResourceGroup_flags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__GREEN__CONTEXTS.html#group__cuda__green__contexts_1ga69abf91a6df3c4ae504a234f9beb4482).

localityDomainId.doc:
Locality domain that the SM must be located on.

Only valid if [`CUdevSmResourceGroup_flags::CU_DEV_SM_RESOURCE_GROUP_LOCALITY_DOMAIN_ID`] is set in flags. If the backfill flag is set, SMs may be assigned from other locality domains.

CUdevWorkqueueConfigResource.doc: Data for workqueue configuration related resources.

device.doc: The device on which the workqueue resources are available.

wqConcurrencyLimit.doc: The expected maximum number of concurrent stream-ordered workloads.

sharingScope.doc: The sharing scope for the workqueue resources.

CUdevWorkqueueResource.doc: Handle to a pre-existing workqueue related resource.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads per block.

maxThreadsDim.doc: Maximum size of each dimension of a block.

maxGridSize.doc: Maximum size of each dimension of a grid.

sharedMemPerBlock.doc: Shared memory available per block in bytes.

totalConstantMemory.doc: Constant memory available on device in bytes.

memPitch.doc: Maximum pitch in bytes allowed by memory copies.

CUeglFrame_v1.doc:
CUDA EGLFrame structure Descriptor - structure defining one frame of EGL.

Each frame may contain one or more planes depending on whether the surface \* is Multiplanar or not.

pArray.doc: Array of CUarray corresponding to each plane.

pPitch.doc: Array of Pointers corresponding to each plane.

numChannels.doc: Number of channels for the plane.

val.doc: The number of SMs the context is limited to use.

CUextent3D_v1.doc: Struct representing width/height/depth of a CUarray in elements.

CUgraphEdgeData.doc:
Optional annotation for edges in a CUDA graph.

Note, all edges implicitly have annotations and default to a zero-initialized value if not specified. A zero-initialized struct indicates a standard full serialization of two nodes with memory visibility.

from_port.doc:
This indicates when the dependency is triggered from the upstream node on the edge.

The meaning is specfic to the node type. A value of 0 in all cases means full completion of the upstream node, with memory visibility to the downstream node or portion thereof (indicated by `to_port`

).

Only kernel nodes define non-zero ports. A kernel node can use the following output port types.

to_port.doc:
This indicates what portion of the downstream node is dependent on the upstream node or portion thereof (indicated by `from_port`).

The meaning is specific to the node type. A value of 0 in all cases means the entirety of the downstream node is dependent on the upstream work.

Currently no node types define non-zero ports. Accordingly, this field must be set to zero.

type.doc:
This should be populated with a value from [CUgraphDependencyType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga4ce440cd353e7761fbf7de1ec963c0b2).

(It is typed as char due to compiler-specific layout of bitfields.) See [CUgraphDependencyType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga4ce440cd353e7761fbf7de1ec963c0b2).

reserved.doc:
These bytes are unused and must be zeroed.

This ensures compatibility if additional fields are added in the future.

result.doc: Gives more specific detail when a cuda graph update fails.

errorNode.doc:
The “to node” of the error edge when the topologies do not match.

The error node when the error is associated with a specific node. NULL when the error is generic.

errorFromNode.doc:
The from node of error edge when the topologies do not match.

Otherwise NULL.

reserved1.doc:
Padding.

Unused bytes must be zero.

blockDimX.doc: X dimension of each thread block.

blockDimY.doc: Y dimension of each thread block.

blockDimZ.doc: Z dimension of each thread block.

sharedMemBytes.doc: Dynamic shared-memory size per thread block in bytes.

CUlaunchMemSyncDomainMap.doc:
Memory Synchronization Domain map.

See ::cudaLaunchMemSyncDomain.

By default, kernels are launched in domain 0. Kernel launched with [CU_LAUNCH_MEM_SYNC_DOMAIN_REMOTE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga471f645fa24df354626fe8107358e05fad06c15e0689a9ec3b9393a32646f5417) will have a different domain ID. User may also alter the domain ID with [CUlaunchMemSyncDomainMap](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUlaunchMemSyncDomainMap.html#structculaunchmemsyncdomainmap) for a specific stream / graph node / kernel launch. See [CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_SYNC_DOMAIN_MAP](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga6f6565b334be6bb3134868e10bbdd331ab05f66cedd0038b77034a8c62127a09d).

Domain ID range is available through [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MEM_SYNC_DOMAIN_COUNT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3ae21f4ac335f51cc411f8059a1348274c).

default_.doc: The default domain ID to use for designated kernels.

remote.doc: The remote domain ID to use for designated kernels.

CUlogicalEndpointFabricHandle.doc: Fabric handle for a logical endpoint.

CUlogicalEndpointProp.doc: Properties of a logical endpoint construction.

type.doc: Type of the logical endpoint defined in [CUlogicalEndpointType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LOGICAL__ENDPOINT.html#group__cuda__logical__endpoint_1ga3c031f02e37776b98f57efc7be9cb7cb).

device.doc: Owner device of the unicast logical endpoint.

numDevices.doc: Number of devices in the multicast logical endpoint team.

size.doc: Size of the logical endpoint.

ipcHandleTypes.doc: A bitmask of IPC handle types defined in [CUlogicalEndpointIpcHandleType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LOGICAL__ENDPOINT.html#group__cuda__logical__endpoint_1ga78d2e6480f2291ec7acd6f77aa419af7).

flags.doc: A bitmask of flags defined in [CUlogicalEndpointFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__LOGICAL__ENDPOINT.html#group__cuda__logical__endpoint_1ga969403103cb8e189997bcf9638e215f0).

location.doc: Location on which the request is to change it’s accessibility.

flags.doc: CUmemProt accessibility flags to set on the request.

CUmemAllocationProp_v1.doc: Specifies the allocation properties for a allocation.

win32HandleMetaData.doc:
Windows-specific POBJECT_ATTRIBUTES required when [CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_WIN32](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9a439b7704f58e569543c4b60038cc251e) is specified.

This object attributes structure includes security attributes that define the scope of which exported allocations may be transferred to other processes. In all other cases, this field is required to be zero.

compressionType.doc:
Allocation hint for requesting compressible memory.

On devices that support Compute Data Compression, compressible memory can be used to accelerate accesses to data with unstructured sparsity and other compressible data patterns. Applications are expected to query allocation property of the handle obtained with [cuMemCreate](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1ga899d69a862bba36449789c64b430dc7c) using [cuMemGetAllocationPropertiesFromHandle](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__VA.html#group__cuda__va_1gac1c4c812caba5a21401c2cb4ab4512b1) to validate if the obtained allocation is compressible or not. Note that compressed memory may not be mappable on all devices.

gpuDirectRDMACapable.doc:
Allocation hint for requesting GPUDirect RDMA capable memory.

On devices with attribute [CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_GPU_DIRECT_RDMA_WITH_CUDA_VMM_SUPPORTED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ggae12b8a782bebe21b1ac0091bf9f4e2a3abc3ee895fbeb9e466f710f2296fef411) set, this flag indicates that the memory will be used for GPUDirect RDMA. On platforms where the default RDMA path does not support localized allocations, this flag has the following effects.

usage.doc: Bitmask indicating intended usage for this allocation.

CUmemDecompressParams.doc: Structure describing the parameters that compose a single decompression operation.

srcNumBytes.doc: The number of bytes to be read and decompressed from ::CUmemDecompressParams_st.src.

dstNumBytes.doc:
The number of bytes that the decompression operation will be expected to write to ::CUmemDecompressParams_st.dst.

This value is optional; if present, it may be used by the CUDA driver as a heuristic for scheduling the individual decompression operations.

dstActBytes.doc: After the decompression operation has completed, the actual number of bytes written to [CUmemDecompressParams.dst](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/structCUmemDecompressParams.html#structcumemdecompressparams_1a39077e823122cfcfab6aeca53093c88c) will be recorded as a 32-bit unsigned integer in the memory at this address.

src.doc: Pointer to a buffer of at least ::CUmemDecompressParams_st.srcNumBytes compressed bytes.

dst.doc:
Pointer to a buffer where the decompressed data will be written.

The number of bytes written to this location will be recorded in the memory pointed to by ::CUmemDecompressParams_st.dstActBytes.

CUmemFabricHandle_v1.doc:
Fabric handle - An opaque handle representing a memory allocation that can be exported to processes in same or different nodes.

For IPC between processes on different nodes they must be connected via the NVSwitch fabric.

type.doc: Specifies the location type, which modifies the meaning of id.

CUmemPoolProps_v1.doc: Specifies the properties of allocations made from the pool.

allocType.doc:
Allocation type.

Currently must be specified as [`CUmemAllocationType::CU_MEM_ALLOCATION_TYPE_PINNED`].

handleTypes.doc: Handle types that will be supported by allocations from the pool.

win32SecurityAttributes.doc:
Windows-specific LPSECURITYATTRIBUTES required when [CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_WIN32](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9a439b7704f58e569543c4b60038cc251e) is specified.

This security attribute defines the scope of which exported allocations may be transferred to other processes. In all other cases, this field is required to be zero.

maxSize.doc:
Maximum pool size.

When set to 0, defaults to a system dependent value.

usage.doc: Bitmask indicating intended usage for the pool.

gpuDirectRDMACapable.doc:
Allocation hint for requesting GPUDirect RDMA capable memory.

On devices that support GPUDirect RDMA, this flag indicates that the memory will be used for GPUDirect RDMA. On platforms where the default RDMA path does not support localized allocations, this flag has the following effects.

reserved.doc: reserved for future use, must be 0.

CUmemPoolPtrExportData_v1.doc: Opaque data for exporting a pool allocation.

CUmemcpy3DOperand_v1.doc: Struct representing an operand for copy with cuMemcpy3DBatchAsync.

ptr.doc: Struct representing an operand when CUmemcpy3DOperand::type is [CU_MEMCPY_OPERAND_TYPE_POINTER](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga507c7c67580a9b998fd8a59ce883c7d4ac8f57f3e6c8b3863359d15cf89aaa593).

rowLength.doc: Length of each row in elements.

layerHeight.doc: Height of each layer in elements.

locHint.doc:
Hint location for the operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

array.doc: Struct representing an operand when CUmemcpy3DOperand::type is [CU_MEMCPY_OPERAND_TYPE_ARRAY](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1gga507c7c67580a9b998fd8a59ce883c7d4a16fd927c15c167e4e734e657f9aa323b).

offset.doc: offset into the array in elements.

CUmemcpyAttributes_v1.doc:
Attributes specific to copies within a batch.

For more details on usage see cuMemcpyBatchAsync.

srcAccessOrder.doc: Source access ordering to be observed for copies with this attribute.

srcLocHint.doc:
Hint location for the source operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

dstLocHint.doc:
Hint location for the destination operand.

Ignored when the pointers are not managed memory or memory allocated outside CUDA.

flags.doc:
Additional flags for copies with this attribute.

See [CUmemcpyFlags](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga0badb1f4f792793fdcf4a78593b4655a).

CUmulticastObjectProp_v1.doc: Specifies the properties for a multicast object.

numDevices.doc: The number of devices in the multicast team that will bind memory to this object.

size.doc: The maximum amount of memory that can be bound to this multicast object per device.

handleTypes.doc: Bitmask of exportable handle types (see [CUmemAllocationHandleType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__TYPES.html#group__cuda__types_1ga450a23153d86fce0afe30e25d63caef9)) for this object.

flags.doc: Flags for future use, must be zero now.
Must be 0.

address.doc: The address the atomic operation will be operated on.

value.doc: The operand value the atomic operation will operate with.
